source: speed check run 5 (2026-11-11): the model text of every number-line candidate turn, in order

outline.title: 用数轴理解 3 + (-5)
goals: 掌握在数轴上用起点和移动向量表示正数与负数加法的方法
理解加负数相当于向左移动，得出 3 + (-5) = -2 的结果
teaching_strategies: 利用数轴直观化加法过程：以 3 为起点，加负数表示向负方向（向左）平移 5 个单位
结合动态演示与数轴刻度指示，清晰展示从 3 移动到 -2 的全过程

sections.purpose: 在数轴上直观演示从起点 3 开始向左移动 5 个单位，求出 3 + (-5) 的结果

close.summary: 在数轴上算加法时，起点是第一个加数；加上一个负数，就是从起点向左平移对应的单位长度，因此 3 + (-5) = -2。

moments.narration: 今天我们用数轴来看看 3 加上负 5 怎么计算。在数轴上做加法，第一个数就是我们的起点。

content.title: 数轴加法规则
items: 移动：加上负数 (-5) 相当于向左移动 5 个单位
终点：落点 -2 即为计算结果

focuses.intent: 观察起点 3 和向左移动 5 个单位到达 -2 的过程

moments.narration: 加上一个正数是向右移动，而加上一个负数，比如加 -5，就表示向左移动 5 个单位。从 3 开始往左数 5 格，正好停在 -2 处。
现在轮到你了！请把移动量调整到 -4，观察从 3 往左移动 4 个单位会落在哪一个位置。

number_activities.prompt: 把移动量调到 -4，看看从 3 开始向左移动 4 个单位的结果是多少。
hints: 拖动第二个滑块（移动量），把它设为 -4。
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！从 3 向左移动 4 个单位到达 1，所以 3 + (-4) = 1。

outline.title: Adding Integers on the Number Line: -2 + 7 = 5
goals: Understand signed numbers as positions and directed movements on a number line
Demonstrate how starting at -2 and moving +7 steps right results in 5
teaching_strategies: Use a visual number line to represent the starting point (-2) as position
Animate the displacement (+7) as a movement to the right
Confirm the landing point (+5) as the final sum

sections.purpose: Visualize the start position at -2 and the move of +7 to reach 5 on the number line.

close.summary: We visualized -2 + 7 on the number line by starting at -2 and taking 7 steps to the right, landing exactly at 5.

moments.narration: To visualize negative 2 plus 7 on a number line, we start by locating our initial position at negative 2.

focuses.intent: Highlight starting point at -2

moments.narration: Adding a positive number means moving to the right. Moving 7 units to the right from negative 2 carries us past zero and brings us straight to positive 5.

focuses.intent: Follow the shift from -2 to +5

moments.narration: Now it's your turn to try! Slide the change control to see how moving 7 units starting from negative 2 brings you to positive 5.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change to +7 to see the full movement from -2 to 5.
hints: Moving to the right corresponds to positive values.
Adjust the second number slider to 7.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! Starting at -2 and moving 7 steps right lands on 5.

outline.title: 3/4 在数轴上的位置与表示
goals: 理解分数 3/4 的几何含义（把单位 1 平均分成 4 份，取其中的 3 份）
掌握在数轴上通过定位起点与移动量准确标出 3/4 的方法
teaching_strategies: 数形结合：将单位长度 [0, 1] 等分成 4 份，从 0 移动 3 个单位份数
动态演示：通过数轴动画展示从起点 0 向正方向累加 3 个 1/4 达到 0.75

sections.purpose: 掌握 3/4 在数轴上的位置确定方法与几何意义

close.summary: 我们学会了把 0 到 1 的单位长度平均分成 4 份，从 0 开始向右数 3 个小格，就能精准找到 3/4（即 0.75）在数轴上的位置。

moments.narration: 要在数轴上找到分数 3/4 的位置，我们首先要理解它的含义：把单位长度“1”平均分成 4 份，取其中的 3 份。
在数轴上，我们从起点 0 开始，向右移动 3 个四分之一的长度。这就对应着数轴上 0 到 1 之间第 3 个分点的位置。

content.title: 定位 3/4 的步骤
items: 1. 观察分母为 4，将 [0, 1] 4 等分
2. 从 0 点出发向右数 3 份

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上从 0 延伸到 3/4 的区间段

moments.narration: 现在轮到你了，尝试在数轴上把移动量调整到 0.75，亲自感受一下 3/4 的位置吧！

number_activities.prompt: 请将数值调整到 0.75（即 3/4），观察它在数轴上的对应点。
hints: 它位于 0 到 1 之间，靠近 1 的位置
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！你准确找到了 3/4 在数轴上的位置。

outline.title: Adding Fractions on a Number Line
goals: Represent starting fraction 1/4 as a jump from 0 on the number line
Add 2/4 by moving forward 2 steps of size 1/4 to reach 3/4
teaching_strategies: Use a fraction-oriented number line with unit steps of 1/4 to visualize vector addition of fractions.

sections.purpose: Demonstrate how to add 1/4 and 2/4 by jumping along a number line partitioned in fourths.

close.summary: Adding fractions with a common denominator on a number line involves starting at the first fraction and moving forward by the second fraction's numerator.

moments.narration: To add one fourth and two fourths, we first locate one fourth on a number line divided into equal fourths.

focuses.intent: Highlight the starting point of 1/4 on the number line.

moments.narration: Starting from one fourth, moving forward by two fourths means taking two steps of one fourth to the right.
Notice how landing on three fourths shows that one fourth plus two fourths equals three fourths. Now it is your turn to try!

focuses.intent: Show final position 3/4 on the number line.

number_activities.prompt: Set the added amount to 2/4 (0.50) to see the jump land on 3/4.
hints: Each tick mark represents one fourth (0.25).
Move the slider to 0.50 to add two fourths.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You showed that 1/4 plus 2/4 equals 3/4 on the number line.

outline.title: 数轴上的加法与温度变化
goals: 理解数轴上的正负数表示
掌握在数轴上演示‘起点 + 变化量 = 终点’的移动过程
teaching_strategies: 通过数轴直观呈现起点（零下3度）与升高的过程（+8度）
借助动画演示沿正方向平移得出结果

sections.purpose: 通过数轴直观推导零下3度升高8度后的实际温度

close.summary: 我们学会了在数轴上用起点加上变化量来计算最终温度：从 -3 开始向右移动 8 个单位，到达 5。

moments.narration: 我们先在数轴上找到起点：零下 3 度，也就是数字 -3。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴起点 -3

moments.narration: 温度升高 8 度，意味着在数轴上从 -3 开始向右移动 8 个单位。
从 -3 向右走 8 步后，指针停在了 5 的位置。所以，温度是 5 度。现在你可以尝试将变化量调整为 5 度，看看结果是多少。

focuses.intent: 观察移动终点 5

number_activities.prompt: 把温度变化量调到 5 度，观察从零下 3 度升高 5 度后的结果。
hints: 拖动第二个滑块，将变化量设为 5。
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！从 -3 向右移动 5 个单位到达 2，说明升高 5 度后是 2 度。

outline.title: Understanding Subtraction on a Number Line: 6 - 9
goals: Visualize starting at positive 6 on a number line
Interpret subtracting 9 as moving 9 units to the left
Determine the final position at -3
teaching_strategies: Use a visual number line to connect movement with integer subtraction
Step through starting point, directional movement, and final result

sections.purpose: Demonstrate 6 - 9 on a number line by starting at 6 and moving 9 units to the left to reach -3.

close.summary: Subtracting a larger positive number from a smaller positive number moves past zero into negative territory, yielding a negative result.

moments.narration: To evaluate 6 minus 9 on a number line, we start at 6.
Subtracting 9 means moving 9 units to the left. As we move left past zero, we land on negative 3.
So, 6 minus 9 equals negative 3. Try adjusting the change slider to see how moving left or right affects the final value!

number_activities.prompt: Set the change value to -4 to find 6 - 4.
hints: Subtracting 4 means moving 4 units to the left from 6.
Move the change slider to -4.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! 6 minus 4 gives 2.

outline.title: 在数轴上比较 0.5 与 0.8 的大小
goals: 掌握在数轴上标出小数 0.5 和 0.8 的位置
理解数轴上右边的数大于左边的数，学会比较 0.5 与 0.8 的大小
teaching_strategies: 利用数轴动态呈现点从原点移动到 0.5 和 0.8 的过程
通过位置的左右对比建立直观的数大小关系概念

sections.purpose: 在数轴上定位 0.5 与 0.8，并通过相对位置比较它们的大小

close.summary: 通过本节课学习，我们知道了在数轴上越靠右的数越大，因为 0.8 在 0.5 的右边，所以 0.8 > 0.5。

moments.narration: 我们要在数轴上比较 0.5 和 0.8 的大小。首先在数轴上标出 0.5 的位置。

content.title: 数轴比较法则
items: 数轴上从左到右数越来越大
右边的数大于左边的数

focuses.intent: 观察 0.5 在数轴上的位置

moments.narration: 接下来，我们将位置移动到 0.8。看，0.8 距离原点更远，在 0.5 的右侧。
因为在数轴上越靠右侧的数越大，0.8 在 0.5 的右边，所以 0.8 大于 0.5。现在请你尝试把位置调整到 0.5，亲自感受一下它在数轴上的位置吧。

number_activities.prompt: 请将数值调整到 0.5 的位置。
hints: 向左移动滑杆直到数值等于 0.5
number_activities.success_message: 非常好！你成功找到了 0.5 在数轴上的位置，它在 0.8 的左边，说明 0.5 < 0.8。

outline.title: Understanding Negative Numbers on the Number Line
goals: Understand that numbers further to the left on a number line have smaller values.
Compare -4 and -1 using positions on a horizontal number line.
teaching_strategies: Use a number line to visualize directions and positions.
Explain inequality using left-to-right orientation.

sections.purpose: Visualize negative numbers on the number line to see why -4 is less than -1.

close.summary: On a number line, values increase from left to right. Because -4 lies to the left of -1, -4 is less than -1.

moments.narration: Welcome! Today we will see why negative four is less than negative one by looking at their positions on a number line.
On a number line, moving right means values get larger, while moving left means values get smaller. Here, negative four is located to the left of negative one.

focuses.intent: Highlight the leftward position of negative four relative to negative one.

moments.narration: Let's move the point to negative one to compare directly.
Notice how negative one is further to the right than negative four. Now try adjusting the position on the number line yourself to explore other numbers!

number_activities.prompt: Set the offset on the number line back to -4 to see its position clearly.
hints: Drag the slider to the left towards negative values.
Stop when the value reaches -4.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You can clearly see that -4 is to the left of -1.

outline.title: 在数轴上理解分数的加法
goals: 掌握如何在数轴上表示起始分数与加法移动量
理解同分母分数相加时分子的累加过程与对应的数轴位置
teaching_strategies: 数轴动态演示起点与移动距离
数轴刻度与分数表示的直接对照

sections.purpose: 演示从 1/3 向右移动 2/3 到达 1 的过程

close.summary: 在数轴上，从 1/3 出发向右移动 2/3 个单位长度，到达的位置正好是 1。

moments.narration: 我们来看数轴。把每个单位长度平均分成 3 份，从 0 出发，第一段的位置就是 1/3。

focuses.intent: 展示数轴上的起点 1/3

moments.narration: 加上 2/3 意味着从 1/3 开始向右继续移动 2 个 1/3 的长度，最终落在了 1 的位置。

focuses.intent: 观察移动到 1 的过程

moments.narration: 试着动手在数轴上拖动，观察从 1/3 出发再加 2/3 的落点吧！

number_activities.prompt: 将移动量调整为 2/3，观察数轴上的终点。
hints: 起点保持在 1/3
向右移动 2/3 个单位
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！1/3 加上 2/3 正好等于 1。

outline.title: Counting by Fourths on a Number Line
goals: Understand how a number line is partitioned into equal fourths.
Count sequentially by fourths from 0 to 2 using step movements.
teaching_strategies: Visual partitioning of whole units into four equal segments.
Step-by-step jump animation to build counting fluency with fractions.

sections.purpose: Demonstrate dividing unit intervals into fourths and step from 0 to 2 along the number line.

close.summary: You have learned how each whole interval is divided into 4 equal segments of 1/4, allowing you to count smoothly from 0 all the way to 2.

moments.narration: To count by fourths, we divide every whole unit into 4 equal parts. Each jump on this number line represents one fourth.
Let's make our first jump from 0 to 1/4, then 2/4, 3/4, and reach 1, which is 4/4.
Continuing past 1, we count 5/4, 6/4, 7/4, and reach 2 wholes, which is equal to 8/4.
Now try moving the slider yourself to set the position to 2 on the number line.

number_activities.prompt: Move the slider to count along the number line all the way to 2.
hints: Each tick mark represents an additional 1/4.
Slide until you reach 2 wholes (8/4).
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You counted all the way to 2 by fourths.

outline.title: 在数轴上理解小数加法
goals: 掌握在数轴上表示小数起点与加法平移的方法
理解从 0.3 出发向右移动 0.4 得到 0.7 的几何意义
teaching_strategies: 数形结合：将 0.3 + 0.4 转化为数轴上的起点与向右平移过程
动态演示：直观展示从起点 0.3 向右移动 0.4 步长到达 0.7 的全过程

sections.purpose: 通过数轴直观推导 0.3 + 0.4 的结果

close.summary: 在数轴上，加法表示从起点向右平移。从 0.3 出发向右移动 0.4 个单位，终点停留在 0.7 处，因此 0.3 + 0.4 = 0.7。

moments.narration: 我们在数轴上来看这个问题。首先找到起点 0.3，它表示加法运算的初始位置。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上的起点 0.3

moments.narration: 加上 0.4，意味着从起点 0.3 开始，向数轴正方向（也就是向右）平移 0.4 个单位。
沿着数轴向右移动 0.4 后，我们可以清晰地看到，终点落在了 0.7 处。所以，0.3 加 0.4 等于 0.7。现在，请你试着将移动量调整到 0.6，看看从 0.3 出发移动 0.6 会到达哪里。

number_activities.prompt: 把移动量调到 0.6，观察从 0.3 出发加上 0.6 的终点位置。
hints: 找到控制‘移动量’的滑动条
将移动量数值向右滑动设为 0.6

outline.title: Adding Fractions on a Number Line
goals: Represent the starting position and fractional move on a number line
Evaluate -1/2 + 3/4 using visual movement to reach 1/4
teaching_strategies: Start at the first fraction on the number line
Move right for positive addition to find the sum

sections.purpose: Visualize starting at negative one-half and moving right by three-fourths to arrive at positive one-fourth

close.summary: We visualized -1/2 + 3/4 on the number line by starting at -1/2 (-0.5) and moving 3/4 (+0.75) units to the right, ending at 1/4 (+0.25).

moments.narration: To evaluate negative one-half plus three-fourths, we start at negative one-half on the number line.

focuses.intent: Highlight the starting point at negative one-half on the number line

moments.narration: Adding positive three-fourths means moving three-fourths of a unit to the right from negative one-half.

focuses.intent: Highlight the rightward movement arrow representing positive three-fourths

moments.narration: Since negative one-half is negative two-fourths, moving three-fourths to the right brings us to positive one-fourth.

focuses.intent: Focus on the ending point at positive one-fourth

outline.title: 在数轴上表示分数的加法
goals: 理解带分数在数轴上的起点位置
掌握在数轴上通过顺次平移表示分数加法的过程
teaching_strategies: 利用数轴动态演示起点与平移向量的关系
将带分数化为小数刻度，直观呈现加法结果

sections.purpose: 用数轴呈现带分数 1又1/2 加上 1又1/4 的起点与累加平移过程

close.summary: 通过数轴可以直观看到，从 1又1/2（即 1.5）出发，向右移动 1又1/4（即 1.25），最终停在 2又3/4（即 2.75）的位置。

moments.narration: 我们要用数轴来表示 1又1/2 加上 1又1/4。首先，加法的第一个数表示起点。1又1/2 等于 1.5。

focuses.intent: 强调数轴上的起点 1又1/2

moments.narration: 加上 1又1/4，代表从起点 1.5 开始，向右平移 1.25 个单位。
沿着数轴向右移动 1又1/4 后，终点落在了 2又3/4，也就是 2.75 的位置。现在请你亲自试一试，把移动量调整到 1.25 观察变化。

number_activities.prompt: 请将移动量滑块滑动到 1又1/4（即 1.25），观察数轴终点的位置。
hints: 1又1/4 对应的数值是 1.25。
向右拖动移动量滑块至 1.25。
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！数轴清晰地展示了 1又1/2 加上 1又1/4 等于 2又3/4。

outline.title: Subtracting on the Number Line: 5 - 8
goals: Understand that subtraction corresponds to moving left on a number line
Visualize starting at 5 and subtracting 8 to reach -3
teaching_strategies: Use a number line to illustrate the initial position and direction of motion for subtraction
Demonstrate step-by-step movement from 5 to -3 using an animated movement parameter

sections.purpose: Demonstrate starting at positive 5 and subtracting 8 to land on negative 3

close.summary: By starting at 5 and moving 8 units to the left on the number line, we land at -3. Thus, 5 - 8 = -3.

moments.narration: To model five minus eight on a number line, we begin by placing our starting point at five.

content.title: Key Rule for Subtraction
items: Subtracting means moving left by 8 units

focuses.intent: Highlight starting point 5 on the number line

moments.narration: Subtracting eight means moving eight steps to the left. As we travel left past zero, we land directly on negative three.
Now it's your turn. Try moving the change amount slider to see how different values shift your position on the number line.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change amount to -8 to show subtracting 8 from 5.
hints: Moving left on the number line represents subtraction.
Drag the slider until the change amount reaches -8.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! Starting at 5 and subtracting 8 brings you to -3.

outline.title: 在数轴上理解从 35 往后数 40
goals: 掌握在数轴上表示起始点与平移量的方法
理解从 35 往后数 40 对应的加法含义与计算结果
teaching_strategies: 直观展示数轴上的起点 35
动态演示从 35 向右平移 40 单位的过程并说明对应加法

sections.purpose: 借助数轴建立从 35 往后数 40 的直观表示，并通过动态平移得出计算结果 75

close.summary: 在数轴上，从 35 往后数 40 相当于在 35 的基础上向右移动 40 个单位，结果是 75。

moments.narration: 我们在数轴上先找到起点 35。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上起点 35 的位置

moments.narration: 从 35 往后数 40，也就是向右平移 40 个单位，到达终点 75。
现在轮到你亲自试一试了，把移动量调整到 40，看看落在哪里的数上。

number_activities.prompt: 把移动量调到 40，观察从 35 往后数 40 是多少。
hints: 滑动移动量滑块，直到数值变为 40。

outline.title: Adding Rational Numbers on a Number Line
goals: Visualize starting at a negative decimal on the number line
Understand addition as moving to the right to find the sum of -2.5 + 4
teaching_strategies: Use a visual number line to connect spatial movement with decimal arithmetic
Decompose movement across zero to make the calculation intuitively clear

sections.purpose: Demonstrate how to locate -2.5 on a number line and move 4 units right to evaluate -2.5 + 4 = 1.5

close.summary: Adding a positive number means moving right on the number line. Starting at -2.5 and moving 4 units right lands at 1.5.

moments.narration: To evaluate negative two point five plus four, we locate negative two point five as our starting point on the number line.

focuses.intent: Highlight the starting point at -2.5 on the number line

moments.narration: Adding four means moving four units to the right. Moving two point five units right brings us from negative two point five to zero, and moving the remaining one point five units right lands us at positive one point five.

focuses.intent: Follow the rightward arrow from -2.5 across 0 to 1.5

moments.narration: Now try setting the starting point to negative two point five and moving four units to confirm the final position yourself!

number_activities.prompt: Set the starting point to -2.5.
hints: Drag the Start Position slider to -2.5.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You positioned the starting point at -2.5.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change value to 4 to move 4 units right.
hints: Drag the Change Value slider to 4.
number_activities.success_message: Perfect! Moving 4 units to the right from -2.5 lands at 1.5.

outline.title: 数轴上的加法与位置移动
goals: 理解数轴上‘起点’与‘向右移动’的数学意义
学会通过数轴表达从 -6 出发向右移动 6 格并得到结果 0
teaching_strategies: 结合数轴动态移动直观呈现从 -6 到 0 的过程
将‘起点 + 向右移动量 = 终点’建立为加法算式的映射

sections.purpose: 利用数轴直观演示从 -6 出发向右移动 6 格的过程，并理解对应的加法运算结果

close.summary: 在数轴上，从 -6 出发向右移动 6 格代表计算 (-6) + 6，结果刚好到达原点 0。

moments.narration: 我们先在数轴上找到起点 -6。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上的起点 -6

moments.narration: 接着，我们向右移动 6 个单位长度。向右移动对应加法运算。
向右走 6 格后，我们正好到达了原点 0。对应的算式就是 (-6) + 6 = 0。

focuses.intent: 强调从起点向右延伸 1 又 1/4 的位移过程

moments.narration: 平移之后到达的位置就是终点。1 又 1/2 加上 1 又 1/4，等于 2 又 3/4，也就是 2.75。
现在请你动手尝试一下，将移动量调整为 0 又 3/4，看看数轴上的终点会变成多少吧！

number_activities.prompt: 请将移动量调到 0 又 3/4（即 0.75），观察数轴上的终点变化。
hints: 起点保持在 1 又 1/2（1.5）不变
将滑动条向左拖动至 0.75（即 3/4）

outline.title: Visualizing Subtraction on a Number Line
goals: Represent starting numbers and negative changes on a number line
Calculate 5 - 8 using directional movement along a number line
teaching_strategies: Use starting position and vector displacement to build intuition for integer subtraction

sections.purpose: Demonstrate subtracting 8 from 5 on a number line by moving left 8 units to reach -3

close.summary: Subtracting a positive integer is equivalent to moving left on the number line. Starting at 5 and moving left by 8 units brings us to -3.

moments.narration: To evaluate 5 minus 8 on a number line, we start at positive 5.
Subtracting 8 means moving 8 units to the left. Moving 5 units left brings us to 0, and moving 3 more units left lands us on negative 3.

focuses.intent: Highlight movement from 5 to -3 along the number line

moments.narration: So, 5 minus 8 equals negative 3. Now try adjusting the change value to subtract 6 instead.

number_activities.prompt: Change the subtraction amount so that you move left by 6 units from 5.
hints: Moving left by 6 units corresponds to a change of -6.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! Starting at 5 and moving left 6 units gives 5 - 6 = -1.

outline.title: 数轴上的加法：从 35 往后数 40
goals: 理解在数轴上“往后数”对应向右平移与加法运算
掌握利用数轴确定起点 35 和移动量 40 后的终点位置
teaching_strategies: 通过数轴直观演示从起点 35 向右移动 40 个单位的过程
结合数轴上的位置变化与加法算式，帮助建立数形结合直觉

sections.purpose: 在数轴上动态演示从 35 向右数 40 的平移过程，计算出终点 75 并与算式建立联系

close.summary: 在数轴上，从某个数往后数几，就是从该起点向右平移对应单位长度，结果等于起点加上平移量。从 35 往后数 40，计算结果为 75。

moments.narration: 我们在 0 到 100 的数轴上找到起点 35。从 35 往后数，就是在数轴上向右平移。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上的起点 35

moments.narration: 向右平移 40 个单位长度后，箭头指向的位置就是 75。
现在请你试一试，把移动量调整到 50，看看从 35 往后数 50 会落在哪一个位置。

number_activities.prompt: 把移动量滑杆调整为 50，观察数轴上的终点。
hints: 拖动第二个滑杆‘移动量’
将数值调整为 50
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！从 35 往后数 50，算式是 35 + 50 = 85。

outline.title: Adding Real Numbers on a Number Line
goals: Understand addition of real numbers as starting at a point and moving along the number line
Calculate -2.5 + 4 using a number line representation
teaching_strategies: Visual representation with number line
Step-by-step vector motion from start value by change amount

sections.purpose: Demonstrate -2.5 + 4 using the number line movement model.

close.summary: We visualized -2.5 + 4 on the number line by starting at -2.5 and moving 4 units to the right, landing on 1.5.

moments.narration: To evaluate negative 2.5 plus 4 on a number line, we first find our starting position at negative 2.5.

content.title: Addition on the Number Line
items: Adding a positive number means moving to the right: +4

focuses.intent: Highlight starting point -2.5 on the number line.

moments.narration: Adding positive 4 means moving 4 units to the right. Moving 2.5 units brings us to zero, and the remaining 1.5 units take us to positive 1.5. Now, try adjusting the change amount to see how it moves on the line!

focuses.intent: Follow the rightward arrow shift from -2.5 to 1.5.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change amount slider to 4 to see the displacement vector from -2.5 to 1.5.
hints: Start at -2.5 on the number line.
Move 4 units to the right.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! Starting at -2.5 and adding 4 lands exactly on 1.5.

outline.title: 在数轴上表示 -6 + 6 的过程与结果
goals: 理解数轴上的起点、移动方向与距离对应的加法意义
掌握从 -6 向右移动 6 个单位到达 0 的直观表示与计算
teaching_strategies: 使用数轴动态演示从起点 -6 开始向右平移 6 个单位的过程
将数轴上的位置变化与加法算式 (-6) + 6 = 0 进行对应解析

sections.purpose: 通过数轴观察从 -6 向右移动 6 个单位的过程，得出算式结果并进行互动验证

close.summary: 我们学习了在数轴上从起点 -6 出发，向右移动 6 个单位到达原点 0 的过程，这在数学上对应算式 (-6) + 6 = 0。

moments.narration: 我们在数轴上标出起点 -6。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴上起点的具体位置

moments.narration: 从 -6 开始向右走 6 个单位，我们来看看位置的动态变化。
向右走 6 格后，正好到达了原点 0。算式写作 (-6) + 6 = 0。现在请你尝试把移动量调整到 6，亲自观察这个过程。

number_activities.prompt: 将移动量调整为 6，观察从 -6 到达 0 的过程
hints: 把移动量从 0 拖动到 6
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！向右移动 6 个单位后，正好到达 0。

outline.title: Subtracting Fractions on a Number Line
goals: Visualize fraction subtraction as moving left from a starting point on a number line
Perform 2/3 - 1/3 using vector movements on a number line divided into thirds
teaching_strategies: Use a fraction-labeled number line to represent 2/3 as a starting position
Demonstrate subtraction of 1/3 as a leftward move of 1/3 unit to arrive at 1/3

sections.purpose: Demonstrate how to locate 2/3 and subtract 1/3 by moving left along the number line

close.summary: Subtracting fractions on a number line starts at the first fraction and shifts left by the subtracted value. Moving 1/3 left from 2/3 lands at 1/3.

moments.narration: To subtract fractions on a number line, we first locate our starting point, two-thirds.
Subtracting one-third means moving to the left by one step of size one-third. Notice how the arrow moves back towards one-third.

focuses.intent: Highlight the leftward arrow representing subtraction of 1/3

moments.narration: Now it's your turn! Try adjusting the change slider to subtract minus one-third and see the final result.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change value to -1/3 to show subtracting 1/3 from 2/3.
hints: Drag the slider left to -1/3.
Subtraction is represented by a negative movement on the line.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You showed that 2/3 minus 1/3 equals 1/3.

moments.narration: Let us visualize subtracting fractions on a number line. To compute 2/3 - 1/3, we first locate our starting point at 2/3.

focuses.intent: Highlight the starting position at 2/3 on the fraction number line.

moments.narration: Subtracting a fraction means moving to the left by that distance. Moving left by 1/3 brings us to 1/3.
So, starting at 2/3 and subtracting 1/3 leaves us with 1/3.
Now try it yourself! Adjust the starting position to 2/3 to see the movement on the number line.

content.title: Subtracting Fractions
items: Start at the first fraction value.
Move left by the value of the subtracted fraction.
The final point is the result.

reflection_activities.prompt: What happens if you subtract 2/3 from 2/3 on the number line?
reflection_activities.answer: Moving left by 2/3 from 2/3 brings you all the way back to 0.

answer_activities.prompt: Compute 4/5 - 2/5. Enter your answer as a simplified fraction.
hints: Subtract the numerators while keeping the denominator the same.
4 minus 2 equals 2, so the fraction is 2/5.

number_activities.prompt: Set the starting point to 2/3 to visualize the fraction subtraction.
hints: Move the starting point slider to 2/3.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You set the starting point to 2/3.

moments.narration: To subtract fractions on a number line, we start at our first value, two thirds, and move left by the amount being subtracted.

focuses.intent: Focus on locating two-thirds on the number line divided into equal third intervals.

moments.narration: Moving left by one third brings us from two thirds down to one third, showing that two thirds minus one third equals one third.
Now it's your turn to set the starting position to two thirds on the fraction line.

content.title: Subtracting Fractions
items: Start at 2/3 on the number line

reflection_activities.prompt: Why does subtracting a fraction mean moving to the left on a number line?
reflection_activities.answer: Moving left represents decreasing values along the number line, which corresponds to taking away or subtracting a quantity.

answer_activities.prompt: What is 4/5 - 1/5 on a number line divided into fifths?
hints: Keep the denominator 5 the same.
Subtract 1 from 4 in the numerator.

number_activities.prompt: Set the starting point slider to 0.67 to represent 2/3.
hints: Two-thirds is approximately 0.67 on the decimal scale.
Slide the start value to 0.67.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! You positioned the start point at 2/3.

outline.title: 用数轴计算 23 + 48
goals: 理解加法在数轴上的几何意义：从起点出发向右平移
掌握通过数轴逐步累加求得 23 + 48 结果的方法
teaching_strategies: 利用数轴直观展示从 23 开始向右移动 48 个单位的过程
通过分步拆解加数（先加 40 再加 8），帮助建立数轴计算的策略

request_coverage.reason: 在数轴上演示 23 作为起点，向右移动 48 得到 71 的全过程。

sections.purpose: 在数轴上表示起点 23，并向右移动 48 个单位计算出结果 71

close.summary: 在数轴上做加法时，被加数是起点，加数代表向右平移的距离，终点所对应的数值即为加法运算的结果。

moments.narration: 我们在数轴上来计算 23 + 48。首先，把起点设定在 23 这个位置。

focuses.intent: 观察数轴起点 23 的位置

moments.narration: 加上 48，意味着从 23 开始，顺着数轴向右平移 48 个单位。最终停止的位置是 71。
现在轮到你来尝试了！请将移动量调整为 48，在数轴上验证结果。

number_activities.prompt: 把移动量调到 48，观察数轴上的终点位置。
hints: 数轴上的起点是 23，加法表示向右平移
滑动滑杆，将移动量设置为 48
number_activities.success_message: 太棒了！数轴上从 23 向右平移 48，终点刚好落在 71 上。

outline.title: Adding 17 and 26 on an Open Number Line
goals: Understand how to represent addition as a movement along an open number line
Break down the addition 17 + 26 into manageable jumps using standard place value decomposition
teaching_strategies: Start at the initial addend 17
Decompose 26 into tens and ones to perform step-by-step forward jumps
Observe the final position on the number line to find the sum

sections.purpose: Demonstrate how to add 26 to 17 on an open number line by starting at 17 and moving forward by 26 units.

close.summary: By starting at 17 and advancing 26 units along the number line, we reach 43. Breaking numbers into jumps makes addition intuitive and clear.

moments.narration: To solve 17 plus 26 using an open number line, we place our starting point at 17.

focuses.intent: Highlight the starting point of 17 on the number line.

moments.narration: Next, we add 26 by jumping forward 26 units from 17 along the line.
Now it's your turn! Try setting the change amount to 26 to see the jump land on 43.

number_activities.prompt: Set the change value to 26 to complete the addition jump from 17 to 43.
hints: The starting number is already at 17.
Adjust the change slider so it equals 26.
number_activities.success_message: Great job! Moving 26 units forward from 17 lands exactly on 43.
